verified_facts: SAM 3.1 is the March 27, 2026 Object Multiplex release.
The recommended public builder is build_sam3_predictor(version='sam3.1').
SAM 3.1 predictors use handle_request and handle_stream_request rather than the SAM 2 init_state/add_new_points_or_box API.
Interactive points and boxes are normalized at the request boundary; boxes are XYWH.
The official SAM 3 setup requires Python 3.12+, PyTorch 2.7+, and CUDA 12.6+; the repository README's current exact example uses PyTorch 2.10.0.
SAM 3.1 propagation responses expose out_binary_masks for each returned frame.
Netflix VOID sequences contain input_video.mp4, quadmask_0.mp4, and prompt.json with a bg background description.
VOID quadmask values are 0 for remove, 63 for overlap, 127 for affected, and 255 for keep.
VOID mask generation clears affected-only grey pixels from frame zero.
VOID Pass 1 is base inpainting; Pass 2 uses Pass 1 output and warped-noise refinement.
VOID's reference requirements pin PyTorch 2.7.1, separate from the SAM 3.1 2.10-oriented setup.
The official SAM 3 runtime import path additionally requires pkg_resources, einops, and triton even though its project metadata does not declare them as base dependencies.
Triton publishes matching current wheels for Linux, not macOS; this Mac therefore cannot import the full CUDA-oriented SAM 3 model module.
implementation_decisions: Keep SAM 3.1 and VOID in separate execution environments.
Pin SAM 3 code as a dependency rather than copying its custom-licensed source into this repository.
Keep the imported SAMURAI/SAM 2 tree as third_party frozen observation and reject canonical sam2 imports.
Use ffmpeg/libx264 with yuv444p and qp=0 for mask videos, matching the reference pipeline's lossless-value requirement.
Borrow explicit text/point CLI and persisted-mask workflow patterns from the surveyed SAM 3.1 repositories, but retain the official request predictor rather than a frame-by-frame image API.
Avoid the surveyed frame-by-frame video mode that explicitly retains no prior-frame object state; it is unsuitable for mask tracking.
Treat independent multiplex explanations as corroboration only; Meta's pinned source remains the implementation authority.
Add setuptools<81, einops, and Linux-marked triton to samurai's sam31 extra; retain a doctor importability check so an installed-but-broken lane cannot be mistaken for readiness.
non_claims: No SAM 3.1 checkpoint was downloaded or executed.
No Netflix VOID checkpoint or CogVideoX base model was downloaded or executed.
No CUDA device was claimed or qualified.
The similar-repository survey is research context, not an endorsement or integration of every surveyed project.
